title: MV Fear and Hunger-style combat system

posts.author: reyezbelto
posts.body: Hello, I need help. I'm trying to make a F&H-style game, but I don't know what I should use to apply the battle system to that game's style. I don't know whether to use RPG Maker MV, MZ, or XP. It would be appreciated if you could tell me what I should do to make it work.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Use either MV or MZ. If you check F&H credits, it lists all the plugins the dude used. I think that's just a "fake sideview" with the battlers shifted. Then you just make sprite sheets where the battles appear to look away. Probably the target selection was made by just making different enemies for torso and limbs and then placing them carefully. Then there's a troop event running which checks that if the head is cut the all the other parts die. But yeah, I don't know, I never played that game.
